newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian shares rise in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian shares rise in dull trade.

text.p: Nigerian shares rose in dull Thursday trading, dealers said.
The all-share index closed at 6483.1 from 6469.67 on Thursday.
"Activity was low except for deals in Afribank after the price drop," one trader said.
Afribank shares fell 10 kobo to 5.80 naira.
Unipetrol rose 30 kobo to 39.00 naira. Mobil was higher by the same margin at 37.50 naira. African Petroleum was 28 kobo higher at 30.48 naira.
West African Portland Cement closed at 31.99 naira with a 29 kobo gain. Construction firm Cappa and D'Alberto rose 23 kobo to 8.00 naira.
Cadbury closed 20 kobo up at 26.20 naira. Flour Mills of Nigeria was 10 kobo higher at 10.50 naira.
Conglomerate UAC fell by five kobo to 11.00 naira on poorly received half-year results posted on Wednesday.

First Aluminium lost three kobo to close at 5.12 naira. Delta Glass fell five kobo to 6.09 naira, despite an improved half-year result announced last week. Avon Crowncaps lost two kobo to end at 4.48 naira. ($1=80 naira)
